title: 第十二章 偷窥第十三章 授艺第十四章 剑法
content_zh:
中饭过后不久，秦凤鸣准时来到大殿右边偏殿之内，此时，偏殿之中，已有许多少年坐在殿中的木椅之中。
秦凤鸣看看众人，其中同来少年居多，但也有几名年岁略大一些的少年，他却从未见过，想来应该是往届弟子。
一盏茶功夫后，一个身穿棕色长衫的老者走进了大殿，目视下面端坐的众少年，声音沉稳说道：“老夫姓史，以后你们就跟随老夫识文断字，希望你们都认真学习，用心记忆。”
众孩子均都站起身，一同给那老者施礼。
然后坐下听那老者教授。
就这样，秦凤鸣众人每日上午提炼石锁，下午、晚上识文断字。
日子就此一天天过去。
半月之后，已然有所根基的众人，在老夫子拿出一幅人体图形后，开始认真熟悉人体骨骼，脉络及穴道方位。
虽然离家日久，但是每天事情繁多，仅有十岁的秦凤鸣，却也未如何想家。
这一日，上午练完石锁，见无其他事情，秦凤鸣便想到丹云峰各处去转上一转。
于是对段猛二人知会一声之后，便独自一人向丹云峰后山行去。
丹云峰后山，树木葱葱，一条蜿蜒小路伸向树林深处。
欣赏着路边风景，秦凤鸣一时流连忘返，不知不觉便深入到山谷很远。
就在秦凤鸣忘却归途，沉醉于四周美景之时，却突听到前方传来‘刷、刷’刀剑劈空之声。
听到此声音，好奇之下，秦凤鸣快步向前奔去。
爬上一块大石，拢目光向声音发出之处望去。
不看则好，一看之下，秦凤鸣登时呆愣在了当场。
只见前面二三十丈之外的小山谷中，此时正有一身穿彩衣年轻少女，正体态轻盈的挥舞着一把长剑。
那女子仿佛仙女下凡，身姿曼妙无比，长剑在其手中，犹如有了灵性一般。
秦凤鸣长这么大，还从未见到过如此清秀艳丽的女子，更加没有见过宝剑能够舞动到如此出神的地步，惊呆之下，他不由口中突然叫出了一声‘好’。

随着秦凤鸣的好字出口，那正自习练宝剑的俊秀少女立即停下身形，抱剑向秦凤鸣处望来。
身形轻动之下，只见其如同月中仙子般，脚踩轻柔的树梢，几个起落就已然到了秦凤鸣近前。
见到面前情形，秦凤鸣登时惊得六神无主，呆愣的站立在当场，不知如何是好。
他此时，心中大为不解，明明一个大活人，竟然能在树枝之上凭空飞跃，这可是他从未想到过之事。
那俊美少女怒视着秦凤鸣，瞧见他身穿灰衣，年岁在十来岁左右，心中已然知晓其身份，皓齿微露，面色微冷道：“你是今年新进弟子吧，因何偷窥我练武？”
秦凤鸣自小聪慧，虽说心中紧张，但片刻就已然恢复了平静。
躬身施礼说道：“我正是刚刚加入落霞谷的弟子，并不知姐姐在此练武，只是觉得无聊，来此处走走，不小心看到了，还请姐姐能够原谅”
那少女看看秦凤鸣，见其一脸镇静，似乎不像是在说谎，于是淡然说道：
“不管你是不是有心，但偷窥别人练武，却大是不该，此次就算了，以后可不要再如此了。
此处多有蛇虫野兽，你还是快些回去吧。
不然可是有生命危险的。”
content_en:
Shortly after lunch, Qin Fengming came to the side hall on the right side of the main hall on time. At this time, there were many young people sitting on the wooden chairs in the side hall.
Qin Fengming looked at the crowd. Most of them were young people who had come with them, but there were also a few slightly older boys that he had never seen before. They must be former disciples.
After a cup of tea, an old man wearing a brown gown walked into the hall. He looked at the young people sitting below and said in a calm voice: "My surname is Shi. From now on, you will follow me in reading and writing. I hope you all study hard and memorize it carefully."
All the children stood up and saluted the old man together.
Then he sat down and listened to the old man's professor.
In this way, Qin Fengming and others refined stone locks every morning, and read and hyphenated characters in the afternoon and evening.
The days passed like this.
Half a month later, after the old master took out a picture of the human body, everyone who had already gained some basic knowledge began to get familiar with the bones, veins and acupuncture points of the human body.
Although he has been away from home for a long time, there are many things to do every day. Qin Fengming, who is only ten years old, does not miss home much.
On this day, after practicing Shisuo in the morning and seeing nothing else going on, Qin Fengming thought of going around Danyun Peak.
So after informing Duan Meng and the others, he walked to the back mountain of Danyun Peak alone.
On the mountain behind Danyun Peak, there are lush trees, and a winding path stretches deep into the woods.
Admiring the scenery on the roadside, Qin Fengming couldn't bear to leave for a while, and unknowingly went very far into the valley.
Just when Qin Fengming forgot about his way home and was intoxicated by the beautiful scenery around him, he suddenly heard the sound of swords chopping the air from the front.
Upon hearing this voice, Qin Fengming ran forward quickly out of curiosity.
Climb up a big rock and look towards the place where the sound came from.
It would be better not to look at it. At first glance, Qin Fengming was stunned on the spot.
In the small valley twenty or thirty feet ahead, there was a young girl in colorful clothes, waving a long sword lightly.
The woman was like a fairy descending to earth, her figure was extremely graceful, and the sword in her hand seemed to have spirituality.
Qin Fengming has never seen such a delicate and beautiful woman in his whole life, let alone a sword that can dance to such an ecstatic level. He was so stunned that he couldn't help but suddenly shouted "Okay".
As soon as Qin Fengming's words came out, the handsome girl who was practicing sword practice immediately stopped and looked at Qin Fengming with her sword in hand.
With a slight movement of his body, he was like a fairy in the moon, stepping on the gentle treetops. After a few ups and downs, he was already in front of Qin Fengming.
Seeing the situation in front of him, Qin Fengming was so shocked that he stood there blankly, not knowing what to do.
At this time, he was greatly puzzled. A living person could actually leap out of thin air above the branches. This was something he had never thought of.
The handsome girl glared at Qin Fengming. She saw that he was wearing gray clothes and was about ten years old. She already knew his identity in her heart. She showed her white teeth and said with a cold expression: "You are a new disciple this year, why are you spying on me practicing martial arts?"
Qin Fengming has been smart since he was a child. Although he was nervous, he regained his composure in a moment.
He bowed and saluted and said: "I am a disciple who has just joined Luoxia Valley. I didn't know that my sister is practicing martial arts here. I just felt bored and came here for a walk. I accidentally saw it. Please forgive me."
The girl looked at Qin Fengming and saw that his face was calm and did not seem like he was lying, so she said calmly:
"Whether you mean it or not, it is absolutely wrong to spy on others practicing martial arts. Forget it this time, don't do it again in the future.
There are many snakes, insects and beasts here, so you'd better go back quickly.
Otherwise, it will be life-threatening. "
